subject: Kickoff: mFACE factuality scoring for multilingual summaries
body:
Hi Santiago,

Kicking off the mFACE track for H1. The pitch: our open-source release ships human judgements over XLSum summaries — per-example min/avg/max scores for comprehensibility (q1), full attributability to the article (q2), and overall quality (q3) — plus ROUGE and an NLI entailment score (e2e_nli_score). We want to turn that into an internal factuality gate for the multilingual summarization products.

Rough milestones inside our Feb 9 – May 11 window:
- End of Feb: judgement data loaded into Evalline, schema agreed with Tomas.
- Early April: NLI scorer reproduced and calibrated against the q2 human labels.
- Early May: launch-review packet for using the scorer as a pre-ship gate.

Product framing for OKRs: "no summary ships in a language where the factuality scorer is uncalibrated." Can you send staffing plus compute asks by end of next week?

Thanks,
Priya
